description: This file defines encoding functionalities for Prometheus metric families, including content negotiation, encoder creation, and interface definitions for encoding and closing metric data.

classes.name: encoderCloser
classes.description: A struct implementing Encoder and Closer interfaces, wrapping encode and close functions.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a MetricFamily into the writer.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the encoder, finalizing the encoding process.

methods.name: Negotiate
methods.description: Performs content negotiation based on HTTP Accept headers, returning the appropriate format.

methods.name: NegotiateIncludingOpenMetrics
methods.description: Performs content negotiation including OpenMetrics support.

methods.name: NewEncoder
methods.description: Creates a new encoder for a specified format and options.
